svg.text: Magic Wand pen: exploded view and parts list
Assembly order: wire the harness on the bench, drop parts into the bottom shell, close the top shell, fit the rear cap.
① TOP SHELL (FSR pocket, PCB hold-down ribs, screw bosses)
② BOTTOM SHELL (PCB ledges, wire channel, button + switch holes)
④ M2 x 8 pan-head screws, 6x (two per position, one each side)
ledges at y = −2, 3 screw bosses per side
self-tapping into printed bosses, or M2 heat-set inserts
puck: Ø6 TPU dome or hot-glue dot
FSR divider, heat-shrunk at the connector
no pin headers; wires soldered under the pads
Micro-USB FPC extension, male to female
female end glued into the rear cap
or any ≥ 200 mA 5 V boost that fits
TP4056 USB-C charger with DW01 protection
set charge current ≤ 1C: swap RPROG for 3.3 kΩ (≈ 360 mA)
between TP4056 OUT+ and boost IN
Magic Wand pen, rev A sketch, 2026-11-08. All dimensions in mm. Not to scale when printed; use the numbers.
